needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous, usable footway at least 1.5 metres wide along the left side of the road.
Remove parked and obstructing vehicles or goods from the right-side footway to ensure full accessibility.
Repair broken or uneven sections of the footway on the left side to eliminate trip hazards.
Repair the uneven sections on the right-side footway to ensure a smooth walking surface.

needed.evidence: crossing_quality is poor due to potential obstruction and visibility issues
needed.suggestion: Install vertical markings and enhance lighting at the crossing to improve visibility and drivers' stopping likelihood.

needed.evidence: 4_or_more lanes with signalised crossing but without a refuge
needed.suggestion: Add a refuge island in the middle of the crossing to provide a safer place for pedestrians on this wide road.

needed.evidence: kerb_ramps are not present on both sides
needed.suggestion: Install kerb ramps on both sides of the crossing to ensure accessibility for pedestrians, especially those with mobility issues.
